faqs.answer: Panels: 10-25 year warranty. Inverters: 2-5 years. Batteries: 2-10 years depending on type. Installation workmanship: 12 months.
Installation usually takes 1-2 days after a site visit. A technician confirms panel placement, wiring and the right system size before we start.
We accept a deposit to book (typically 50-70%) with the balance on installation. Ask our team about payment plans.
Solar needs very little care: rinse panels now and then and have the system checked once a year. We offer service plans.
Batteries store power for the night and cloudy periods. Panels still make some power on cloudy days, just less.
